title: Roast Vegetable Shawarma
description: A flavorful and healthy vegetarian version of the popular Middle Eastern street food. Roasted vegetables are served in a warm pita with creamy tahini sauce.

ingredients.name: Uncharted Roast Vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as eggplant, zucchini, and red bell pepper

ingredients.name: Arabic Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: such as cumin, coriander, and paprika

instructions: Toss the uncharted roast vegetables with olive oil, Arabic spice blend, and lemon juice.
Spread the vegetables on a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
Warm the pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for 5 minutes.
Assemble the shawarma by spreading tahini sauce on the pita bread, followed by roasted vegetables, cucumber, tomato, and a sprinkle of Arabic spice blend.
